summary: Refine reusable report library cards, move visualization information out of pills and align contextual actions
acceptance: Template and saved-report cards share readable source/type information without squeezing titles or exposing duplicate source codes
Card actions align consistently with responsive sizing and appropriate emphasis for open, template and destructive actions
All five labeled steps remain visible at 320px, mobile and tablet widths without clipping or horizontal scrolling
Differentiate completed, current and upcoming steps with accessible state labels in Vietnamese and English
Use a compact back link and introduction while preserving workflow state and validation
Save feedback stays beside Save, disappears after four seconds and never occupies a workspace row
Other actionable notices remain visible until dismissed, and save feedback clears on edits
Report brand pills retain 12px typography without inheriting global logo styles at any viewport or stylesheet order
Provide a localized five-step report builder with detail and summary workflows, supported related data, filtering, preview and saving through Studio
Explain source grain, field meaning, formats, aggregation and join limitations using authorized metadata
Warn before source resets and distinguish stale execution results from unsaved changes
Validate guided workflow behavior, existing reporting tests, types, lint, formatting and i18n
Verify mobile, tablet and desktop layouts and keep the active guide step visible
Preserve advanced Studio workflows and existing report access controls
